title: NIFTY Midcap 150 P/E Ratio
description: The NIFTY Midcap 150 P/E ratio today is 26.5 as of 27 Oct, 2026, against a 10-year median of 33.2. The midcap premium or discount to the NIFTY 50 is a cleaner read on risk appetite than the absolute multiple, and it typically widens when domestic flows are strong.
